acceptance_contract.scope: Secondary mathematics curriculum grade 7 (Linear Equations) to grade 8 (Quadratic Equations)
acceptance_contract.method: Tripartite synthesis of formal proof, curriculum standards, and empirical data

verification.details: Algorithmic alternative (quadratic formula) demonstrates multiple CAS solution paths, but pedagogical scaffolding across general student cohort remains unproven without empirical student trajectory data.

acceptance_contract.limitations: Topic-level necessity across general quadratics remains unproven; curriculum sequence does not equal strict necessity.

acceptance_contracts_all.scope: Univariate quadratic equations ax^2 + bx + c = 0 with real numeric a != 0 and D >= 0
acceptance_contracts_all.method: Closed-form Quadratic Formula pathway comparison vs linear solver requirement

verification.details: Exact symbolic CAS root substitution P(r) == 0 without invoking linear equation solving

acceptance_contracts_all.limitations: Refutes the universal claim that every quadratic solution algorithm must invoke a linear solver.

acceptance_contracts_all.scope: Factoring and Zero Product Property method on factorable quadratics in Q[x]
acceptance_contracts_all.method: Linear factor extraction and zero-product linear equation solving

verification.details: Linear factor decomposition over Q[x], zero-product solving, root substitution, and FTA polynomial reconstruction a*(x-r1)*(x-r2) == P(x)

acceptance_contracts_all.limitations: Applies strictly to factoring method; inapplicable to non-factorable quadratics.
